tagline: Global financial innovator offering a diverse suite of ETPs, models, solutions, private market investments and digital asset-related products.
hero_kpi_rationale: Assets Under Management (AUM) is the primary indicator of the company's size and growth in the asset management sector, reflecting its ability to attract and retain client investments.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management
kpis.explanation: Total amount of assets managed by the company for its clients.
kpis.description: Assets Under Management (AUM) is the total amount of assets that an investment management company manages on its behalf. It is a key indicator of a company's size and success.
kpis.signal: Significant AUM growth of 31.6%, demonstrated by strong capital attraction dynamics and favorable market conditions.

kpis.name: Operating Margin Expansion
kpis.explanation: Improvement in operating margin compared to the prior period.
kpis.description: Operating margin expansion indicates an improvement in the profitability of operations relative to revenues.
kpis.signal: Notable operating margin expansion of 300 basis points, a sign of increased efficiency and improved revenue capture supported by higher average AUM.

kpis.name: Net Inflows
kpis.explanation: Difference between inflows and outflows of funds from the company's products.
kpis.description: Net inflows represent the net amount of money that has entered or exited the funds managed by the company.
kpis.signal: Positive net inflows of $8.5 billion, indicating investor confidence and annualized organic growth of approximately 8%.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management: Farmland
kpis.explanation: Assets under management in farmland-related strategies following the Ceres acquisition.
kpis.description: Farmland AUM represents investments managed in strategies related to agricultural land in the United States. This acquisition marked WisdomTree's entry into private assets and demonstrates expansion into an important and underexposed asset class.
kpis.signal: Ceres acquisition added $1.9 billion of AUM in agricultural assets, diversifying the platform into private assets with low correlation to traditional financial markets and generating over 200 basis points of operating margin expansion.

kpis.name: Assets Under Advisement: Portfolio Models
kpis.explanation: Assets managed through portfolio model solutions for financial advisors.
kpis.description: Assets Under Advisement (AUA) in models represent assets managed by the company for financial advisors through predefined portfolios, including shared CIO services and customized evaluations.
kpis.signal: 60% growth in assets under advisement for portfolio models, supported by increased adoption among major wealth management platforms and registered investment advisors.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management: Digital Assets
kpis.explanation: Assets under management in products related to digital assets and tokenization.
kpis.description: Digital assets AUM includes investments in products such as tokenized digital funds, stablecoins, tokenized bitcoin, ether and U.S. dollar tokens. This category demonstrates the potential of real asset tokenization, with future applications planned in fixed income and equities.
kpis.signal: Digital assets AUM of $0.8 billion, driven by expansion of the WisdomTree Treasury Money Market Digital Fund and institutional adoption via WisdomTree Connect.

kpis.name: New Products Launched
kpis.explanation: Number of new Exchange Traded Products (ETPs) and Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) launched during the year.
kpis.description: The launch of new financial products such as ETPs and ETFs is an indicator of the company's innovation strategy and product range expansion. These launches cover all investment universes including equities, commodities, fixed income, inverse leveraged products and alternative assets.
kpis.signal: Launch of 25 new European ETPs and 12 U.S. ETFs, covering all major product categories, demonstrating continuous product innovation. Notably, the WisdomTree Europe Defence UCITS ETF has accumulated $3.9 billion of AUM.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €1.51 billion in the last year

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.
